**What is the issue you are having?**
Provide some context in terms of what you were trying to do e.g. "I was trying to do a audit/scan"

Provide some info on what happened e.g "I ran the command teemops register and got a 404 error".

**How do you expect to work instead?**
Give a brief example of how you think this should work. e.g "When I run the command teemops register I expect to see some prompts for my email and password".

**Any console output to help with being able to understand the problem you are having**
